title: Brand templates
subtitle: Your frame, made once — every photo becomes an on-brand post and story.
usedTimes: {count, plural, =0 {Not used yet} one {Used once} other {Used # times}}
emptyText: Upload your frame once — a PNG with a transparent window — and every photo is framed for you, as a post and as a story.
how1: Design your frame in Canva or Photoshop at the post size (1080×1350) with a transparent hole where the photo goes, and export it as PNG.
how2: Create a set (e.g. “Offers”) with a post template and a story template, upload the frames: the photo window is found automatically.
how3: In Quick publish (or from Telegram), pick photos and the set: they come out framed, ready to publish.
setNameHint: Short and easy to type, e.g. Offers — it is also the word you use in Telegram.
setKitHint: Logo and colours used by the templates of this set.
deleteSetText: “{name}”: keep its templates (without a set) or delete them too?
deleteTemplateText: The template and its frame are deleted. Posts already made with it are not changed.

editor.stageHint: Drag the boxes to move them, drag a corner to resize. The preview updates by itself.
editor.frameHint: PNG with a transparent window where the photo shows.
editor.noWindow: This image has no transparent area: the photo goes under the whole frame. Draw the box by hand or export the frame as a PNG with transparency.
editor.backgroundHint: Shown where neither the photo nor the frame covers the canvas.
editor.textDefaultHint: e.g. a price or a headline; it can be changed for each post.
editor.textOffHint: Add a zone for a price, a headline or a date — written on every photo.
editor.noLogo: Your brand kit has no logo yet — add one in the brand kit settings.

quick.title: Quick publish
quick.subtitle: Your photo in your brand frame — as a post, a story or both, in seconds.
quick.noTemplatesText: Upload your frame once — a PNG with a transparent window — and every photo is framed for you.
quick.askAdmin: Ask an editor to add your brand templates.
quick.dropHint: Drop photos here, or pick one you used before:
quick.notMedia: {name} is not a photo or a video.
quick.caption: Caption
quick.captionPlaceholder: What do you want to say? (stories have no caption)
quick.aiPlaceholder: Your idea, e.g. 20% off all coffee this weekend
quick.noStoryOn: No stories on {names}: only the post is published there.
quick.oneFormat: This set has a single format: it is used for the post and the story.
quick.noFfmpeg: Framing videos needs ffmpeg on the server.
quick.previewEmpty: Add a photo to see it in your frame.
quick.draftHint: Saved as a draft: open it to review and publish.

telegram.title: Publish from Telegram
telegram.subtitle: Send a photo to your Telegram bot with a short command — it comes back framed and published (or saved as a draft).
telegram.noBot: Connect a Telegram bot in Accounts first; then message it privately from an allowed account.
telegram.publishersHint: Telegram @usernames or user ids, separated by commas. Nobody else can publish.
telegram.defaultSetHint: Used when the caption does not start with a set name.
telegram.accountsHint: None selected: your Instagram and Facebook accounts.
telegram.aiCaption: Polish every caption with AI (or add #ai to a caption)
